questions.question: Except where a special permission or deviation applies, what is the maximum number of supply services permitted to a single building?
solution_steps: Keyword 'number of supply services' jumps to Rule 6-102.
A building is limited to ONE supply service unless a deviation is granted; the consumer's-service limit (four) is the separate Rule 6-104 figure.
questions.question_fa: به‌جز در مواردی که special permission یا انحراف خاصی اعمال شود، بیشترین تعداد supply service مجاز برای یک ساختمان واحد چند است؟

questions.question: What is the maximum number of consumer's services that may be supplied from one supply service, unless otherwise permitted?
solution_steps: Keyword 'number of consumer services' jumps to Rule 6-104.
Maximum FOUR consumer's services from a single supply service unless a deviation applies (contrast with the single supply service of Rule 6-102).
questions.question_fa: بیشترین تعداد consumer's service که می‌تواند از یک supply service تغذیه شود، مگر در مواردی که مجاز شمرده شده باشد، چند است؟

questions.question: At a service head, the consumer's service conductors should emerge through individually bushed holes at a point not less than ______ above the conductor attachment.
solution_steps: Keyword 'service-head point of emergence' jumps to Rule 6-116.
Conductors emerge 150 to 300 mm ABOVE the attachment; minimum is 150 mm, with a maximum of 600 mm horizontally from the attachment.
questions.question_fa: در یک service head، service conductorهای مصرف‌کننده باید از سوراخ‌های بوش‌خورده مجزا و در نقطه‌ای نه کمتر از ______ بالاتر از محل اتصال هادی (conductor attachment) بیرون بیایند.

questions.question: The point of emergence of conductors from a service head shall not be more than ______ horizontally from the conductor attachment to the building.
solution_steps: Keyword 'service-head point of emergence dimensions' jumps to Rule 6-116.
Vertical emergence is 150-300 mm above the attachment; the horizontal limit from the attachment is a maximum of 600 mm.
questions.question_fa: نقطه خروج هادی‌ها از یک service head نباید بیش از ______ به‌صورت افقی از محل اتصال هادی به ساختمان فاصله داشته باشد.

questions.question: To allow the supply authority to form a drip loop and make the service connection at the service head, the minimum length of free (spare) conductor that should be left is approximately ______.
solution_steps: Keyword 'drip loop / spare conductor at service head' jumps to Rule 6-112 / 4-302.
Leave a minimum of about 750 mm of extra conductor at the service head for the drip loop and connection.
questions.question_fa: برای اینکه supply authority بتواند یک drip loop تشکیل دهد و اتصال service را در service head برقرار کند، حداقل طول هادی آزاد (اضافی) که باید باقی گذاشته شود تقریباً ______ است.

questions.question: Where service conductors pass over a roof that is not readily accessible, the general minimum vertical clearance above the roof surface is ______.
solution_steps: Keyword 'roof clearance of service conductors' jumps to Rule 6-112.
General roof clearance is 915 mm above the roof, reducible to 600 mm over the limited drip-loop area at the attachment.
questions.question_fa: در جایی که service conductorها از روی یک سقف که به‌راحتی قابل‌دسترسی نیست عبور می‌کنند، حداقل فاصله عمودی عمومی نسبت به سطح سقف ______ است.

questions.question: Over the limited area adjacent to the point of attachment (the drip-loop area), the roof clearance for service conductors may be reduced to not less than ______.
solution_steps: Keyword 'roof clearance of service conductors' jumps to Rule 6-112.
The 915 mm general roof clearance may be reduced to 600 mm over the small drip-loop area near the attachment.
questions.question_fa: روی محدوده کوچک مجاور point of attachment (ناحیه drip loop)، فاصله سقف برای service conductorها می‌تواند تا حداقل ______ کاهش یابد.

questions.question: A service mast used to support overhead service conductors shall be constructed of ______.
solution_steps: Keyword 'service mast' jumps to Rule 6-112.
A service mast must be metal (rigid steel/metal conduit) of adequate size; non-metallic raceway and EMT are not acceptable mast material.
questions.question_fa: یک service mast که برای نگه‌داشتن service conductorهای هوایی استفاده می‌شود باید از جنس ______ ساخته شود.

questions.question: When is a service mast required to be guyed or otherwise additionally supported?
options: A) Whenever the mast passes through a roof
B) When the unguyed projection above the topmost support exceeds about 1.5 m
C) Only when the mast is non-metallic
D) Only on services rated over 200 A
questions.answer: When the unguyed projection above the topmost support exceeds about 1.5 m
solution_steps: Keyword 'unguyed mast projection / when is a guy wire needed' jumps to Rule 6-112.
Projection above the topmost support beyond roughly 1.5 m requires guying or additional support to handle conductor tension.
questions.question_fa: در چه شرایطی لازم است یک service mast مهار (guy) شود یا به‌نحو دیگری تقویت گردد؟
options_fa: هر زمان که mast از میان یک سقف عبور کند
وقتی بیرون‌زدگی مهارنشده بالای بالاترین نقطه اتکا از حدود 1.5 m تجاوز کند
فقط زمانی که mast غیرفلزی باشد
فقط روی serviceهای با رِیتینگ بالای 200 A
questions.answer_fa: وقتی بیرون‌زدگی مهارنشده بالای بالاترین نقطه اتکا از حدود 1.5 m تجاوز کند

questions.question: Which of the following locations is NOT permitted for the installation of consumer's service equipment?
options: A) In a clothes closet or where headroom is less than 2 m
B) On an exterior wall near the point of entry
C) In a dedicated electrical room
D) In a utility/mechanical room with adequate clearances
questions.answer: In a clothes closet or where headroom is less than 2 m
solution_steps: Keyword 'service equipment location / headroom' jumps to Rule 6-206.
Service equipment must NOT be in a bathroom, clothes closet, coal bin, where headroom is less than 2 m, or where ambient is normally over 30 degrees C.
questions.question_fa: کدام‌یک از مکان‌های زیر برای نصب تجهیزات service مصرف‌کننده مجاز نیست؟
options_fa: در یک کمد لباس یا جایی که headroom کمتر از 2 m باشد
روی دیوار بیرونی نزدیک نقطه ورود
در یک اتاق تأسیسات/مکانیکال با فضای کافی
questions.answer_fa: در یک کمد لباس یا جایی که headroom کمتر از 2 m باشد

questions.question: Consumer's service equipment shall not be installed in a location where the ambient temperature normally exceeds ______.
solution_steps: Keyword 'service equipment location' jumps to Rule 6-206.
Prohibited where ambient normally exceeds 30 degrees C (along with bathroom, closet, coal bin, and headroom under 2 m).
questions.question_fa: تجهیزات service مصرف‌کننده نباید در مکانی نصب شوند که دمای محیط به‌طور معمول از ______ بیشتر شود.

questions.question: The minimum ampere rating of the service box (main disconnect/overcurrent device) for a one-family dwelling is determined primarily by ______.
options: A) the size of the meter base supplied by the utility
B) the calculated service demand load determined under Section 8
C) the trade size of the service raceway
D) the height of the point of attachment
questions.answer: the calculated service demand load determined under Section 8
solution_steps: Keyword 'service / feeder demand load (interface to Sec 8)' jumps to Rule 8-200 / 8-202.
Service size comes from the calculated demand (Section 8); conductors are then sized in Section 4. The box rating follows that demand, not the raceway or meter.
questions.question_fa: حداقل رِیتینگ آمپری service box (کلید قطع اصلی/وسیله اضافه‌جریان) برای یک واحد مسکونی تک‌خانواری عمدتاً بر اساس ______ تعیین می‌شود.
options_fa: اندازه meter base تأمین‌شده توسط شرکت برق
بار demand محاسبه‌شده service طبق Section 8
trade size مربوط به service raceway
questions.answer_fa: بار demand محاسبه‌شده service طبق Section 8

questions.question: A single-dwelling service calculation under Section 8 yields a minimum demand of 19 200 W on a 120/240 V single-phase supply. What is the minimum service ampacity (and hence service-box rating selection basis) before rounding up to a standard size?
solution_steps: Keyword 'service demand load' links Section 6 sizing to Rule 8-200.
I = P / V = 19 200 W / 240 V = 80 A; this drives conductor and service-box selection, then round up to the next standard rating (e.g., 100 A) noting the 100 A dwelling minimum.
questions.question_fa: یک محاسبه service برای واحد مسکونی تکی طبق Section 8، حداقل demand برابر 19 200 W روی تغذیه تک‌فاز 120/240 V به‌دست می‌دهد. حداقل ampacity مربوط به service (و در نتیجه مبنای انتخاب رِیتینگ service box) پیش از گرد کردن به اندازه استاندارد چقدر است؟

questions.question: For an underground consumer's service, the supply authority normally makes the service connection (splice) ______.
options: C) at a hand-hole midway along the run
solution_steps: Keyword 'connection / splice point (overhead vs underground)' jumps to Rule 6-112.
Overhead = connection at the service head; underground = connection at the meter, with no mid-run splice.
questions.question_fa: برای یک consumer's service زیرزمینی، supply authority معمولاً اتصال service (splice) را در ______ برقرار می‌کند.
options_fa: در یک hand-hole در میانه مسیر

questions.question: The grounding of a consumer's service (system and equipment bonding, location of the grounding connection) is governed primarily by ______.
solution_steps: Service grounding/bonding is cross-referenced out of Section 6 to the grounding and bonding rules.
Section 10 governs grounding of the service, including the grounding electrode and system/equipment bonding at the service box.
questions.question_fa: grounding مربوط به consumer's service (bonding سیستم و تجهیزات، محل اتصال grounding) عمدتاً توسط ______ تعیین می‌شود.
